title: TRANSFER OF FUNDS relative to the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 Regional Threat Assessment Center (FY26-27 RTAC) Grant Subaward and Funding Agreement.
text:
[Council File 21-0460-S5]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSFER OF FUNDS relative to the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 Regional Threat Assessment Center (FY26-27 RTAC) Grant Subaward and Funding Agreement.
Recommendation for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
AUTHORIZE the Controller to transfer from Fund No. 339/70, account number to be determined, to Fund No. 100/70, account numbers and amounts as follows:
Account No. 001092, Overtime Sworn; Amount: $45,505
Account No. TBD, Related Costs; Amount: $4,495
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Scheduled pursuant to Council action of September 16, 2026.)
summary: Council is asked to authorize a Controller transfer of $45,505 for sworn overtime and $4,495 for related costs to cover the FY 2026-27 Regional Threat Assessment Center grant subaward.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 14, 2026)
